title: GrainSegmentation: SAM-based segmentation of WC grains in SEM images of WC-Co cemented carbides
description: Unsupervised segmentation of WC grains in backscattered-electron SEM images of WC-Co cemented carbides: Segment Anything Model (ViT-H, no fine-tuning), label-map resolution of overlapping masks and exhaustive convex decomposition of merged grains guided by a prior on interior angles. Includes grain-descriptor analysis and a reproducibility check against the reference segmentation (example data: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22974892).
